queries.query: SELECT id,title,done FROM public.todos ORDER BY id
SELECT id,title,done FROM public.todos WHERE done=false ORDER BY id
SELECT count(*)::integer AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE done)::integer AS completed FROM public.todos

SELECT current_database() AS database_name, pg_backend_pid() AS backend_pid, inet_server_addr()::text AS server_address, inet_server_port() AS server_port, current_setting('server_version') AS server_version, clock_timestamp()::text AS server_time, current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS transaction_read_only

authentication_note: Authentication is supplied from the private file in memory and omitted entirely from evidence.
